tools.name: search_hackathons
tools.description: Search hackathons listed on 黑123 (hack123.henryht.sh). Bilingual (zh/en) fields; every result has its site URL. status: upcoming = start date in the future, open = deadline today or later, ended = deadline passed (dates in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_hackathon
tools.description: Get one hackathon by slug (the part after /h/ in the site URL), with bilingual details, official sources, related works and active team posts.

tools.name: search_team_posts
tools.description: Search active team-up (looking for teammates) posts from 黑123 /team. Expired posts are excluded with the same rule as the site.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search hackathon projects (works) collected on 黑123 /works, by hackathon and/or tag. Tags are bilingual, e.g. agent / Agent, education / 教育学习, web / 网页应用.
